title: refactor(pagination): simplify component further
body:
**Summary**

* default props aren't needed
* keys aren't needed
* className instead of additionalClassName
* simplify tests (still passed with previous implementation)
* deduplicate repetitive part of PaginationLink

**Result**

* all items mentioned in https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/pull/4981 after merge are solved
* bundlesize a tiny bit smaller again
